Hadith.4099 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Ibrahim al-Karkhi, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a man who took a piece of land or a house as collateral (rahn) for his money, and both the land and the house produced abundant yield.
Imam (as) said: "It is upon the one who took the land and the house as collateral for his money to calculate what he has taken from the yield and deduct it from the debt owed to him."
